messages:
Jordan (CS): Heads-up — customer (acct 8432) opened a blocker: rerank API started returning errors after they rotated models in their staging config. They think the new model id is valid but scores are missing/erring.

Jordan (CS): Paste from customer: they call our rerank endpoint with what they believe is a rerank model id. Example request they sent:

```http
POST https://api.redwood.example/v1/rerank
Authorization: Bearer xxxxx
Content-Type: application/json

{
  "model": "rdrk-rank-v1",
  "query": "best laptop under 1000",
  "candidates": ["doc:aa1", "doc:bb2", "doc:cc3"]
}
```

Jordan (CS): Response they got:

```json
{
  "error": {
    "code": "ModelDeprecatedError",
    "message": "model \"rdrk-rank-v1\" is deprecated or not supported for rerank."
  },
  "request_id": "req_01GxYzAbc"
}
```

Jordan (CS): They said this worked yesterday and they only swapped the model id in their config to try a new candidate.

Samir - Eng: Thanks — can you ask for the full raw request headers and the exact request_id? need to correlate with logs.

Jordan (CS): Got the details, customer sent `req_01GxYzAbc` and the exact body above, headers included `X-Client-Env: staging` and `x-app-version: 2.3.1`.

Support Bot: Log entry found for req_01GxYzAbc at 2026-03-04T14:12:11Z, route=/v1/rerank, status=422, backend=ranker-v1, model_tag=rdrk-rank-v1

Alex P: Hmm backend shows `ranker-v1` which is the legacy ranking backend (not reranker). Looks like they passed a ranking-only model id to the rerank endpoint — that explains the deprecated/model mismatch error.

Jordan (CS): Customer insists `rdrk-rank-v1` is a valid model identifier. They copied from their internal list.

Samir - Eng: Two things: 1) our model registry recently consolidated naming and deprecated some `-rank-` ids in favor of `-rerank-` family. `rdrk-rank-v1` is still discoverable by model-list but it's flagged `type: ranking` and not allowed for rerank calls. 2) Our API should return a clearer error: `unsupported_model_operation` instead of generic `ModelDeprecatedError`.

Maria G: I'll send the KB link to the customer that documents model families, but we should also check if their config management auto-updated IDs. Could be a bot that replaced `-rerank-` with `-rank-`.

Ryan - Infra: Quick mitigation option for them: change model id to a known rerank model, e.g. `rdrk-rerank-v2` in the request. Should be backward compatible w/ same schema.

Jordan (CS): Customer tried `rdrk-rerank-v2` locally and got valid scores back. They want to know why our API didn't reject `rdrk-rank-v1` earlier or at validation time.

Samir - Eng: Root cause: server side routing maps model ids to backend pools by tag. We accepted the id, routed to ranking backend which returned a backend-specific error. We didn't have pre-validation that the model supports the `rerank` operation.

Samir - Eng: Proposed fix: add a schema validation step in the request path to check model capability bits (supports: ["generation","embedding","rerank"]) and return 422 with a human-friendly message if operation unsupported. I can take this.

Maria G: Action items: 1) I will update public KB and onboarding doc to emphasise `-rerank-` family for rerank requests (owner: Maria). 2) Samir to add validation + unit tests and a short changelog blurb (owner: Samir). 3) Ryan to add an alert when we see >=5 deprecated-model rerank attempts in 10m (owner: Ryan).

Alex P: Also recommend we add a helpful error payload suggesting the closest compatible models, e.g., `try rdrk-rerank-v2` in the error response. That will cut down support churn.

Samir - Eng: Agreed. I'll plumb a `suggested_models` array into the error response. Quick patch ETA: 2 days for backend + tests, then staging rollout.

Jordan (CS): Customer accepted workaround to change to `rdrk-rerank-v2`. They asked us to notify when the validation is live so they can re-run their config sync.

Maria G: I'll email the customer and include the KB link and note the validation rollout window.

Ryan - Infra: I created an alert dashboard tile for deprecated model misuse. Will set the threshold low for the first week so we can measure.

Samir - Eng: Will open PR now (link: https://github.com/redwood-inference/ranker/pull/482). Tests included for capability validation and suggested_models injection.

Jordan (CS): Awesome — please ping me on the PR when you merge. I'll confirm with the customer and close the ticket. :thumbsup:

Samir - Eng: PR opened. CC @Maria G to review error wording.

Maria G: Reviewing now. Suggest we phrase message like: `Model \"{id}\" does not support rerank. Try one of: {suggested_models}`

Support Bot: Deploy pipeline triggered for ranker service (staging) by samir at 2026-03-05T03:10:00Z.

Samir - Eng: Merged and staged. Rolling to prod after a short soak.

Jordan (CS): Customer confirmed they switched to `rdrk-rerank-v2` and are unblocked. They want a note in their ticket when prod rollout finishes.

Ryan - Infra: Prod rollout complete at 2026-03-05T09:42:10Z. Monitoring shows zero new deprecated-rerank attempts after rollout (good signal).

Jordan (CS): Closing loop with customer, will mark as resolved once KB updated and we email them. Thanks team!

Alex P: Quick retrospective: we should add model capability bits into model-list API and UI so customers can filter by supported operations. Low-effort, high impact.

Maria G: Added to docs backlog.

Samir - Eng: Noted — I'll add a follow-up ticket to expose capability bits from the model registry.

Jordan (CS): Closing thread.
